review_rule: Every test file that existed at the I4 entry commit and differs now is an exact-set member. Its normalized entry-to-current diff and current file bytes are frozen here; any later change requires a renewed assertion disposition.

dispositions.old_assertion: Every Deploy summary row had to remain a single unwrapped line of at most nine characters and report a text-fit PASS at 150% UI scale.

dispositions.scope_preserved: Unavailable-wallet semantics and the authoritative upper-right transaction geometry remain tested in the context where the value affects a decision.
